title: Expulsions and "hostility to mankind"
summary: The speaker says "they were kicked out of over 100 countries over the last 2000 years" and asks whether the people who expelled them were "just a bunch of anti semites for no reason at all." He says the Apostle Paul, "a genuine Israelite," realised "these people are hostile to all mankind," and that they think of others as "useless goy cannon fodder."

evidence.text: Other sources (deck slide 9; guide) put the number of expulsions much lower, noting that widely shared lists count the same places more than once. They note that expulsions were often tied to rulers taking property or cancelling debts, and that other groups were also expelled, such as Muslims from Spain and Protestants from France.
The guide notes that being expelled shows a group was targeted, and does not by itself establish what the group did. (Guide, slide 9)
In the New Testament, Paul describes himself as "a Jew" and "a Pharisee." (deck slide 6; guide)
"Goy" is the Hebrew and Yiddish word for "nation" or "non-Jew." The speaker does not give a source for the "cannon fodder" reading.
No Bible verse is cited for "hostile to all mankind."

title: Edom, Esau and Jacob: "small and greatly despised"
summary: The speaker says "the Bible says that Edom throughout history will always be small and greatly despised" and asks, "Who fits that bill more, the Europeans or the Ashkenazi?" He says Israelites and "those who claim to be Jews" are "not the same thing. They're Edom." He cites "Jacob have I loved, Esau have I hated," says that according to Ezekiel the Edomites helped Babylon take and plunder Jerusalem, and says "Jacob and Esau struggled in the womb and they're still struggling today."

evidence.text: Other sources note that these verses refer to the ancient nation of Edom and describe Edom and Israel as two separate peoples, and that Edom ceased to exist as a nation about 2,000 years ago. (deck slide 4; guide and glossary)
The deck notes that linking ancient Edom to present-day communities would need evidence of continuity between them. (deck slide 2)
How a group is regarded by others is not usually treated as evidence of its ancestry.
The Ezekiel passage refers to the ancient kingdom; the speaker does not give the verse number.
The remark about "European descent" at 00:20 is garbled in the captions.

title: Herod, the Idumeans and the forced conversion
summary: The speaker says "King Herod is an Edomite" and identifies "a group that says they are Jews and are not but lie" as the Idumeans, "forcefully converted by John Hyrcanus after the Maccabean revolt during the Hasmonean dynasty in 125 BC." He says Rome and the world called them Jews, but "the actual Israelites called them half Jews." He says King Antigonus called Herod "1/2 Jew, an Edomite," and that "it's written in Josephus and other records."

evidence.text: Josephus, whom the speaker cites, writes that the Idumeans became Jews. The guide adds that one king's family background does not determine the ancestry of a whole population. (deck slide 5; guide)
Herod's father's family was Idumean. (Glossary)
The phrase "say they are Jews, and are not" appears in the Book of Revelation, in letters to two churches. (deck slide 7; guide)

title: The Sanhedrin, the Pharisees and Judas
summary: The speaker says Herod "is recorded as slaughtering the Sanhedrin and replaces it with a heavily Edomite Sanhedrin," and that many of the Pharisees Jesus "has his run-ins with are Edomites, not actual Jews." He says "Judas Iscariot means Ish Cariath, or man of Kerioth," that Kerioth "was northern Edom, southern Judah," and that "every other disciple comes from Galilee." Later he says that just as people should not "assist Judas in crucifying Jesus just because it's prophesied," they should not "assist the Edomites in bringing the Antichrist."

evidence.text: The deck notes that no ancient source is named for a Sanhedrin refilled with Edomites. (deck slide 5)
Other sources note that the Bible lists Kerioth among the towns of Judah, and that Paul described himself as a Pharisee. (deck slide 6; guide)
"Man of Kerioth" is one of several scholarly explanations of "Iscariot"; it refers to a town.
The statement that every other disciple came from Galilee was not checked here.

title: The crucifixion, the "great deception" and the "synagogue of Satan"
summary: The speaker says Esau was "heavily involved in the crucifixion of our Lord Jesus" and that "we're all under this great deception." He says, "Woe to you who support the synagogue of Satan, even if you're doing it and you don't know," and calls it "a cosmic war" that is "led by those who say that they are Jews and are not but lie." He speaks of "how deep the tentacles are inside of our lives."

evidence.text: Other sources note that the phrase "synagogue of Satan" appears in letters to two early church communities in present-day Turkey, about 1,900 years ago. The guide notes that major churches today do not hold Jews as a group responsible for Jesus' death. (deck slide 7; guide)
Other sources read the Esau verses as referring to the ancient nation of Edom. (deck slide 4)

title: The war in Gaza
summary: The speaker says people believe "they're the Israelites... so we should just do what they say, which includes genocide in Gaza." He points to Gaza and Lebanon as signs of border expansion. He says "there were groups watching and cheering the destruction of Gaza from the hillsides. They'd have a little barbecue," and adds, "God says I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked."

evidence.text: The guide notes that many people, including many Jews, criticise the Israeli government, and distinguishes views about a government's actions from views about Jewish people generally. (deck slide 20; guide)
Whether the war meets the legal definition of genocide is a contested question.
No source is given for the hillside account; it describes specific individuals.

title: Epstein as an alleged Mossad asset
summary: The speaker says "a Mossad asset is bringing children to politicians" who "get it on video so that they can control that politician," referring to Jeffrey Epstein. He calls it "parasite behavior" that is "learned from the devil."

evidence.text: Other sources note that Epstein was a convicted sex offender, and that in 2025 the U.S. Justice Department said it found no evidence of a blackmail scheme. (deck slide 21; guide)

title: Churchill's debts and the "180"
summary: The speaker says "they have more than one method. Money." He says "Winston Churchill was a huge anti Zionist," got into debt, and "guess who bailed him out? Major Jewish banking," after which Churchill did "this 180," "similar to Trump."

evidence.text: Other sources note that a financier did cover Churchill's stock-market losses in 1938, and that Churchill had expressed support for a Jewish homeland from around 1908. (deck slide 14; guide)
The comparison to Donald Trump is not explained further in the video.

title: Third Temple, Antichrist and "Greater Israel"
summary: The speaker says "these people are destined to grow in power leading up to the Third Temple, the Antichrist," and that they say "we have a right to Zion." He tells viewers to "research something called Pax Judaica and Greater Israel," quotes Rabbi Fishman's testimony to the UN that "the promised land extends from the river of Egypt up to the Euphrates. It includes parts of Syria and Lebanon," and says "they want to take it by force." He says some Muslim scholars identify "these Israelis" as Edomites. He describes a plan "to expand their borders, weaken major superpowers, become the new superpower, implement Noahide laws... build the third Temple and coronate the Antichrist," says "they're meeting on those later this year," and says, "Woe to you and your lot of Zionist Christians. They are serving Israel instead of Jesus Christ."

evidence.text: Other sources note that one rabbi described very large borders in 1947 and that Israel's current prime minister has spoken of "Greater Israel," and that Noahide laws are a religious teaching with no means of enforcement. (deck slide 15; guide)
The deck notes that claims based on prophecy are difficult to test. (deck slide 23; guide)
Other sources trace Christian Zionism to Christian preachers in the 1800s reading their own Bibles. (deck slide 11; guide)
Sources for "Pax Judaica," the Muslim scholars and the meeting "later this year" are not identified.

title: Media, money and positions of power
summary: The speaker says, "Look into the owners and the CEOs of **** companies, of music companies, of media companies, of news organizations, and you will find Jews in strategic positions," so "that they can control." He says "a rabbi owns" a company whose name is starred out in the captions, and tells viewers, "Because you're afraid to be called a Nazi, you will be called one."

evidence.text: Other sources note that some executives are Jewish and most are not, and that large companies are owned by many competing shareholders. (deck slide 19; guide)
Other sources trace the idea of hidden control of media to the Protocols of the Elders of Zion, a document identified as a forgery in 1921. (deck slide 19; guide)
The company names are starred out in the captions.

title: The Bolshevik Revolution and Holocaust education
summary: The speaker says of the Bolshevik Revolution that "they didn't do everything themselves. They convinced Russians to do things, but they were in strategically powerful positions." He says it killed "20 million at the least" and that "some estimates go up to 60 million," with "thousands of martyrs" added to the Russian Orthodox Church. He says "all we learned about was Holocaust all day. We just learned to hate Germans," and that people are "taught to have empathy towards Jews and never question them from childhood."

evidence.text: Other sources note that some early Communist leaders had Jewish parents but had left Judaism, that the Soviet government closed synagogues, that Stalin, who was not Jewish, led the largest killings, and that tens of thousands of Jews were also killed in that period. (deck slide 13; guide)
The guide notes that the Nazis used a "Jews are Communists" story in their propaganda. (deck slide 13; guide)
Other sources note that U.S. states decide textbook content. (deck slide 16; guide)
Death-toll estimates for the Soviet period vary widely depending on what is counted, and no curriculum is named.

title: Textbooks and Robert Maxwell
summary: The speaker says "you didn't learn it in school because Jews own the textbooks." He says Robert Maxwell "bought a publishing company for like 2 billion, then partnered with one of the biggest printers in the United States," calls him "provably a Mossad asset," and says "they assassinated him when he was going to turn on them on his yacht." He adds that "it starts in childhood."

evidence.text: Other sources note that Maxwell bought a publisher in 1988, that his company collapsed after his death in 1991, and that today's textbooks are made by investor-owned companies, with states deciding the content. (deck slide 16; guide)
Sources for the intelligence and assassination statements are not identified, and the printer is not named.

title: The ADL, the Leo Frank case and slavery in 1860
summary: The speaker says, "I don't care what the ADL says. The ADL rescued a Jew from doing evil and blamed a black man," and that "40% of Jewish households owned slaves in 1860."
names: Leo Frank (named in the deck, not in the transcript)

evidence.text: The deck connects the ADL remark to the Leo Frank case. Other sources note that Frank was lynched in 1915 and later pardoned by the state of Georgia. (deck slide 12; guide)

Other sources note that most American Jews in 1860 lived in the North, where slavery was illegal, and that Southern Jews owned slaves at about the same rate as their white neighbours. (deck slide 12; guide)
The transcript does not name the man; the Leo Frank link comes from the deck.

title: Talmud and Kabbalah quotations
summary: The speaker says, "Here's their book. It's called the Talmud," and cites Sanhedrin "504B" (probably 54b), Niddah 44b, Bava Metzia 114b, Avodah Zarah 22b and Avodah Zarah 26b, describing what he says each one teaches. He says "the Kabbalah is even darker" and that "they keep" it "secret."

evidence.text: Other sources describe the Talmud as thousands of pages of rabbinic discussion, note that individual lines are often quoted without their surrounding context, and point to other passages, including one forbidding fathers to marry off young daughters and one requiring help for poor and sick non-Jews. (deck slide 8; guide)
The glossary notes that the Talmud records arguments between rabbis rather than a single rulebook.
Kabbalah texts are published and widely available.
The tractate references are given as heard in the captions and were not checked against the text.

title: "Different gods" and Freemasons
summary: The speaker says, "Myself and the Jew who isn't a Jew, they're an Edomite, do not worship the same God." He says, "Freemasons are Zionists," that they "infiltrate Christian churches" and "teach Pro Zionist propaganda inside of Christian churches," and that "they've infiltrated the government."

evidence.text: Other sources describe Freemasonry as a fraternal society founded in England in 1717, and trace Christian Zionism to Christian preachers in the 1800s. (deck slide 11; guide)
Whether Jews and Christians worship the same God is a theological question on which traditions differ.

title: Birthright, DNA and "Canaanite blood"
summary: The speaker says "these people have been false converts. They're Esau's descendants. They want the birthright back," and that "their own leading geneticists can't prove they're Israelites," quoting "Doctor Carreki": "we don't have DNA from the Israelites of the Bible." He says "modern studies reveal these people are Canaanite blooded," quotes a Tel Aviv University review that "most of today's Jewish and Arabic speaking populations share a strong genetic link to the ancient Canaanites," and says "these Ashkenazi people are full of Edomite Canaanite blood."

evidence.text: Other sources note that the same ancient ancestry appears in Lebanese, Jordanian and Palestinian populations, that ancient Israelites themselves came largely from Canaanite peoples, and that there is no DNA test for "Edomite" ancestry. (deck slide 18; guide)
The absence of ancient Israelite DNA leaves the question open in either direction.
"Doctor Carreki" could not be identified, and the review quotation was not checked against the original.

title: "Fatness of the earth," the Rothschilds and wealth
summary: The speaker says of Esau, "you'll actually be very wealthy... You're going to have the fatness of the earth," and links this to Satan offering Jesus "all these kingdoms and all this riches." He says "Rothschild in German... means red shield. But in Hebrew... it literally becomes Shield of Edom." He says "eight of the 20 wealthiest families on earth" fit this and that "Jews are only .2% of the world's population."

evidence.text: Other sources note that Jacob receives the same "fatness of the earth" blessing in Genesis. (deck slide 4; guide)

Other sources note that "Rothschild" means "red shield," from a sign on the family's house in Frankfurt, and that the 2025 list of richest families does not match the "eight of the 20" figure. (deck slide 10; guide)
The 0.2% figure was not checked.

title: Epstein, the Rothschilds, Ghislaine Maxwell and the Nickelodeon logo
summary: The speaker says "Epstein in the Epstein files is representing the Rothschild family... not an individual Rothschild, the family," that Epstein's partner ("Kiss Lane" in the captions, Ghislaine Maxwell) "is the daughter of Robert Maxwell," and that "Epstein is who taught you in school." He says "the Nickelodeon logo is Little St. James Island."

evidence.text: Other sources confirm that Ghislaine Maxwell is Robert Maxwell's daughter, and note that Epstein received money from one bank linked to one Rothschild family member. (deck slide 21; guide)
Fact-checkers found that the logo is Nickelodeon's 1980s logo brought back. (deck slide 22; guide)

title: Epstein's painting of the Massacre of the Innocents
summary: The speaker says Jeffrey Epstein "lauded the child killer King Herod. He commissioned a huge 9 by 9 painting of the slaughter of the innocents from Matthew chapter 2 verse 16 for his Zorro ranch," and calls Herod "an Edomite. Just like Jeffrey Epstein."

evidence.text: Other sources say Epstein bought a copy of a well-known painting of the scene, a Christian artwork traditionally understood as a warning against cruelty. (deck slide 22; guide)
The guide says "bought a copy"; the speaker says "commissioned." The size was not checked.

title: The "dancing Israelis" on 9/11
summary: The speaker says "these people rejoice over evil and violent things," refers to "celebrating tragedies 9/11, we know the dancing Israelis," and says that after "a Freedom of Information Act demand, the FBI had to release the files" showing "these men were celebrating, documenting the destruction of the twin towers," and that "they went back to Israel and admitted that they were Mossad agents."

evidence.text: Other sources confirm that five Israeli men were seen filming and celebrating, and report that the FBI found no evidence they knew of the attack in advance and that they did not admit being intelligence agents. (deck slide 17; guide)
The transcript's phrase "Mossad agents in Gaza" is unclear.
